name: timer
description: Work timer per Claude Code session, with tools that let Claude book the time on a timesheet, and a CSV export

reminderTime.title: Booking reminder
reminderTime.description: Time of day (HH:mm, Italian time) from when the band shows the timers still to book and reminds you to ask Claude to book them

retentionDays.title: Keep booked timers for
retentionDays.description: Days a booked timer is kept after it stopped; time not yet booked is kept however old

agentTime.title: Time with subagents
agentTime.description: wall-clock counts the timer's own time; summed adds every subagent's run while the timer runs, so parallel agents each count

awayTime.title: Time away
awayTime.description: What happens to the time a running timer counts while you are away (no activity for idleMinutes, or the computer asleep): ask when you are back, discard it, or keep counting it

idleMinutes.title: Away after (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: Minutes with no typing, prompt or press, and Claude not working, after which a running timer counts you away; 0 counts only a sleeping computer

branchChange.title: Branch changes
branchChange.description: When the worktree of a running timer moves to another branch: keep counting on the same timer, or split, stopping it and starting a new timer named after the new branch

parallelTime.title: Timers run at once
parallelTime.description: How today's totals count timers that ran at the same time in several sessions: wall-clock counts that time once, summed adds every timer's own time
